reports.title: KNIFE RIVER CORPORATION REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026 FINANCIAL RESULTS

guidance.heading: •Updated 2026 guidance to reflect near-term headwinds
section: BISMARCK, N.D. — November 3, 2026 — Knife River Corporation (NYSE: KNF), an aggregates-based, vertically integrated construction materials and contracting services company, today announced financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.
